hook.say: Fjords, forests and thousands of islands. Can you name these five countries of Northern Europe by shape?

outro.say: How many did you get? Comment your score!

questions.fact: Norway: its longest fjord, the Sognefjord, runs about 205 km inland.
questions.sayAnswer: Norway! Its longest fjord, the Sognefjord, runs about 205 kilometers inland.

questions.fact: Sweden is the largest and most populous of the Nordic countries.
questions.sayAnswer: Sweden! It is the largest and most populous of the Nordic countries.

questions.fact: Ireland: so green that the island is nicknamed the Emerald Isle.
questions.sayAnswer: Ireland! So green that the island is nicknamed the Emerald Isle.

questions.fact: Denmark: its capital Copenhagen sits mainly on the island of Zealand.
questions.sayAnswer: Denmark! Its capital, Copenhagen, sits mainly on the island of Zealand.

questions.fact: Estonia has more than 2,000 islands in the Baltic Sea.
questions.sayAnswer: Estonia! It has more than 2000 islands in the Baltic Sea.
